description: STORM OS desktop defaults for new user profiles (default user hive). Conservative, documented Windows settings that every user can change back in Settings.

settings.name: Dark mode for apps
settings.reason: Storm's dark-first design; matches the STORM OS theme.
settings.userChange: Settings > Personalization > Colors > Choose your mode

settings.name: Dark mode for Windows
settings.description: Taskbar, Start and system surfaces start in dark mode.
settings.reason: Storm's dark-first design; matches the STORM OS theme.
settings.userChange: Settings > Personalization > Colors > Choose your mode

settings.name: Hide the Task View button
settings.description: The Task View button is not shown on the taskbar (Win+Tab still works).
settings.reason: Clean taskbar with fewer default buttons.
settings.userChange: Settings > Personalization > Taskbar > Taskbar items > Task view

settings.name: Hide the Widgets button
settings.description: The Widgets button is not shown on the taskbar (Win+W still opens the board).
settings.reason: Clean taskbar; no feed content next to games.
settings.userChange: Settings > Personalization > Taskbar > Taskbar items > Widgets

settings.name: Search as icon
settings.description: Search is shown as an icon instead of a search box.
settings.reason: Clean taskbar; search stays one click (or the Windows key) away.
settings.userChange: Settings > Personalization > Taskbar > Taskbar items > Search

settings.name: No automatically installed suggested apps
settings.description: Windows does not silently install promoted apps for new users.
settings.reason: Minimal clutter and no unrequested background downloads.
settings.userChange: Set the value to 1 (no Settings page exposes it).

settings.name: No suggestions in Start
settings.description: Start does not show app suggestions.
settings.userChange: Settings > Personalization > Start > Show recommendations for tips, shortcuts, new apps, and more

settings.name: No tips and suggestions notifications
settings.description: Windows does not show tips and suggestions as notifications.
settings.userChange: Settings > System > Notifications > Additional settings > Get tips and suggestions when using Windows
